title: Day 102: Trump Says Iran Downed US Apache Near Hormuz; CENTCOM Launches Retaliatory Strikes on Air-Defense/Radar Sites
detail: Trump said Iran shot down a US Army Apache helicopter patrolling the Strait of Hormuz; both aviators were rescued safely. Trump vowed a military response. CENTCOM began strikes hitting Iranian air-defense, ground-control, and surveillance-radar sites near Hormuz, calling it 'a proportional response to unjustified Iranian aggression.' Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi warned 'foreign forces in proximity to our territory are at constant risk.'

media.caption: Trump vows to respond after Iran downed a US Army helicopter near Strait of Hormuz
